summary: Sandbach United fell to a 3-2 defeat at Foley Meir in a frustrating encounter where they created chances but failed to capitalize, with Saul Shotton grabbing a late consolation goal. The Bach's defensive lapses proved costly, particularly from set pieces and soft free kicks, while they also struggled with marking in the box during the first half. They'll look to bounce back when they face Stafford Town on Saturday.
